UX surfaceShared primitives every surface builds on — no direct UI.

Members

backingDpr

Backing store at clamp(devicePixelRatio, 2, 3) — the 2px floor keeps the 1px SDF edges crisp on 1× displays; the 3× ceiling caps fill cost on phones (the widget is only 54×28 CSS px anyway).

triggerFallback

Switches to the non-WebGL path — releases any live GL, then hides the canvas so the CSS fallback shows.

init

Boot sequence: GL init → event binding → render start; fully degrades to the fallback path.

tryWasm

Attempts the WebGPU wasm switch (~48KB artifact, own GPUDevice). MANUAL drive: this class keeps its own spring loop, so the bridge only initializes the surface. On any failure initRest() runs the exact previous path (WebGL → 2D → CSS).

  • @param host The switch whose canvas the wasm widget should claim.

initRest

The classic boot tail — WebGL attempt → 2D fallback → events + loop. Runs directly on no-WebGPU browsers and after a wasm mount failure.

  • @param host The switch to bring up on the classic path.

initWebGL

Creates the WebGL context, compiles the shader program and sets up uniforms/buffers; falls back on any failure.
